name: network_snapshot
summary: Snapshot devices and their readable logic values in one frame, filtered by reference_ids, prefab_hash, name_contains and logic_types. Returns 2 devices by default (max_devices). Read only.

help.text: Narrow it with the filters first: every matching device reads every logic type it exposes unless logic_types names some. max_devices sets how many devices come back (default 2).

reference_ids.description: Only these devices, by reference id.

name_contains.description: Part of the device's name, any case.

items.description: A logic type name (Temperature) or number.

logic_types.description: Logic types to read; left out, every one each device exposes.
